name: SAfA Valor
desc: A former hacktivist radicalised by the 2008 financial crisis. Brilliant strategist and smart contract developer driven by a fierce belief in self-sovereignty.

name: Niva ReBorN
desc: Former intelligence operative who grew disgusted by state-level corruption. Master of OPSEC, social engineering, and physical infiltration.

name: Nato Saka
desc: SAfA's childhood friend and a hardware genius who can build secure mining rigs from scrap parts. Trusts circuits and steel more than people.

name: Kyra Blaze
desc: Data scientist who once built predictive algorithms for hedge funds. Can read a blockchain transaction log like a story, spotting anomalies through complex chains.

name: Luna Myst
desc: Brilliant mathematician who understands the deep magic of zero-knowledge proofs and consensus algorithms. The heart of the team and a passionate educator.

name: Zayne Nexus
desc: Former systems architect for the Dark Node. His knowledge of the enemy's infrastructure is unparalleled, but his motives remain unclear.
